In `animation_mixer.cpp:2380`, `reference_animation->track_get_unique_id(i)` returns `93929421410856` (in my case), but `track_cache` doesn't have such key, so `static_cast` tries to cast `nullptr` and segfaults.
I was also able to replicate this. Worth noting that it only crashes for me after saving the project.
I've opened a PR with a fix: the capture path now skips tracks whose path couldn't be resolved instead of dereferencing a null cache entry.
